title: My RPG Game GodScar: Interior Rooms
author: irbrandonl
selftext:
Hey everyone! Back with another little development update for GODSCAR, my dark fantasy turn-based RPG!

This is actually some older development footage I've been holding onto for a while, showing off a small glimpse of the game's interior environments.

One thing I've really been focusing on is making the world feel alive, even in the smallest details. Whether it's the colorful stained-glass windows in the temple, windows that actually let you see the world outside, or the little decorations and environmental details that give each room its own personality, I want every location to feel like it has a purpose and a story behind it.

I've always appreciated RPGs where you can walk into a random building and feel like someone actually lives or works there, rather than it just being another room with a few objects thrown inside. That's something I'm really trying to capture with GODSCAR.

Of course, everything is still a work in progress, and there's plenty more to improve, but I wanted to share another glimpse of what I've been working on!

I'll also be showing off the battle system soon! I'm planning to start bringing in playtesters even sooner, so if you're interested in helping test GODSCAR and providing feedback, please leave a comment! I'd love to get some fresh perspectives as development continues.

As always, any feedback, suggestions, or criticism are welcome. I appreciate everyone who's been following along with the development so far!

Made with Claude Opus 5.5 in Godot on Extra Effort
